0.original: Falkbryda would summon you to action.

1.original: Falkbryda asks you to infiltrate the Serpent's Tongue and use makeshift bombs to destroy the crystals, so that the Sahagin will have no means by which to summon Leviathan.

2.original: You have blown the crystals into a thousand thousand fragments. Report your success to Falkbryda.

3.original: Falkbryda thanks you for your part in preserving the peace. Let Radolf know that the Sahagin advance has been halted.

4.original: Now that the Sahagin menace has abated, the Scions may seek to remedy the other maladies of the realm.

24.original: Use the makeshift bombs to destroy the boxes of crystals.

48.original: The Serpent Reavers leave us no choice. The risk of the crystals falling into Sahagin hands is too great for us to remain idle. It comes time to act.

49.original: So many are the crystals that we have no means of recovering them. We can only hope to destroy them.

50.original: While losing the crystals is regrettable, we have far more to lose should Leviathan be summoned.

51.original: Our forces will bombard the Reavers, drawing them out of their den so that you might slip in with these makeshift bombs and destroy the crystals.

52.original: The Serpent's Tongue lies beyond Tidegate and the Sahagin Landbase, at the very heart of the enemy encampment.

53.original: Our comrades will do their utmost to distract the enemy, but the explosions will surely draw the attention of nearby forces. Be prepared to defend yourself.

56.original: Our triumphant hero returns! And I imagine it will be some time before the Serpent Reavers and the Sahagin rear their ugly heads again.

57.original: More importantly, we needn't worry about Leviathan rearing his head.

58.original: The Maelstrom, and indeed all of Limsa Lominsa, owes you a debt of gratitude. And please send my regards to Radolf!

59.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, so good of you to return. Tales of your deeds precede you!

60.original: Knowing Limsa Lominsa lay in good hands allowed us to tend to matters of import elsewhere, but I am relieved to have you back with us all the same. Much work remains for the realm.
